text: dsh-github-panel 是面向 DSH 网页端的 GitHub 控制台，通过侧边栏面板和宿主端接口连接 GitHub。用户可浏览仓库、议题和拉取请求，查看提交与通知，并让 agent 调用 GitHub API。它还能把 GitHub 仓库克隆到本机并同步，或将仓库中的技能安装进 DSH 技能库。适合希望在 DSH 内处理 GitHub 仓库、复用技能项目的用户；连接 GitHub 需要个人访问令牌，克隆需要本机安装 Git。

dsh-github-panel adds a GitHub console to DSH Web. Browse repositories, issues, pull requests, commits and notifications, or call GitHub through an agent tool. Clone repositories locally and install their skills into DSH. Connecting requires a GitHub personal access token; cloning also requires Git.
想在 DSH 里直接浏览和处理 GitHub 仓库、议题和拉取请求。
让 agent 帮我从 GitHub 安装一个仓库里的技能到本地技能库。
Can I clone a GitHub repository in DSH and keep my local copy synced?
dsh-github-panel 的功能「GitHub 仓库操作」：在 DSH 网页面板查看并操作 GitHub 数据，宿主端通过 GitHub REST API 处理请求。用户可在面板操作，agent 也可调用已注册的 API 工具。
dsh-github-panel 的功能「技能项目安装」：给出 GitHub 仓库和可选子目录后，插件读取其中的 SKILL.md 与文件，并写入 DSH 的本地技能目录，便于 agent 后续调用。
dsh-github-panel 使用前须知：GitHub API 请求会携带个人访问令牌发送至 api.github.com；令牌存于 DSH 主机的插件数据文件中。（见 index.js:71-75、index.js:221-235）

dsh-github-panel README · dsh-github-panel：A GitHub console for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) that runs inside the app: paste a personal access token once and work with your repositories, issues, pull requests, commits, notifications, stars, cloning and skills without opening github.com.

中文说明见下方 [中文](#中文).

dsh-github-panel README · Features：| Area | What you get |
| --- | --- |
| Repositories | List every repository you can access, search locally, browse the file tree and preview file contents |
| Issues | Open/closed filter, create an issue, comment, close or reopen |
| Pull requests | List, inspect, comment, merge |
| Commits | Recent commits with author, message and time |
| Notifications | Unread threads, mark one or all as read, jump to the referenced issue/PR |
| Stars | Everything you starred, with instant unstar, and searching |
| Social | Who you follow, who follows you, your organizations |
| Activity | Your public events and the events of the people you follow |
| Clone | Clone a repo from your repositories, stars or search to disk, then keep it up to date automatically |
| Skills | Install a whole GitHub skill project into `~/.dsh/skills`, grouped by category with Chinese descriptions and AI search keywords, and keep it in step with upstream |

dsh-github-panel README · Features：Data is read from the GitHub REST API on every refresh, so the panel and github.com never drift apart. A background refresh runs every 60 seconds while the panel is visible.

dsh-github-panel README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:gpta76/dsh-github-panel
```

Or from a local checkout:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-github-panel
```

Restart DeepSeek Harness after installing, then open **GitHub** in the sidebar.

dsh-github-panel README · Connect：1. Create a token at <https://github.com/settings/tokens>.
   - Classic token: `repo`, `read:user`, `notifications`.
   - Fine-grained token: repository contents, issues and pull requests read/write, plus your profile.
2. Paste it into the panel and press **连接** / **Connect**. The token is verified with `GET /user` before it is stored.

The panel lives in the web UI but every GitHub call is made by the host process, so no CORS proxy is involved and the token never enters the browser.

dsh-github-panel README · Where the token is stored：`$DSH_HOME/plugin-data/github-panel.json` (mode `0600`), i.e. `~/.dsh/plugin-data/github-panel.json` on a default install. An older build wrote the token into the shared credential store; that record is migrated to the file and removed on first read.

The panel does not share the token with anything else, and **断开** / **Disconnect** deletes it.
dsh-github-panel README · Tools for the agent：The host half registers eight tools, so the agent can drive GitHub, the clone cache and the skill library on its own:

dsh-github-panel README · Tools for the agent：| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `github_api` | Call any GitHub REST endpoint (`method`, `path`, optional `body`) through the stored token |
| `github_skill_list` | List skills in the local catalog with their source repository |
| `github_skill_install` | Install `owner/repo` (optionally a `dir` and `ref`) into `~/.dsh/skills` |
| `github_skill_remove` | Remove an installed skill by name |
| `github_skill_project` | `list`, `install` or `remove` a whole skill project (`repo`), with category, summary and keywords |
| `github_clone_list` | List local clones with branch, upstream, ahead/behind and dirty state |
| `github_clone` | Clone `owner/repo` (optionally a `ref`) into the clone root |
| `github_clone_sync` | Fetch and fast-forward one clone, or `all: true` |

dsh-github-panel README · Cloning：Auto-sync runs every 15 minutes by default and can be switched off or re-timed in the panel. The panel shows a live progress bar (overall percentage plus the current git phase) while cloning or fetching.

Git must be installed and on `PATH`. On Windows the panel runs git with `http.sslBackend=openssl`, which avoids the Schannel `SEC_E_NO_CREDENTIALS` failure some machines hit.

dsh-github-panel README · Skills library：Cloning a repository does **not** install its skills: the agent only loads `~/.dsh/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`. The panel therefore has two separate actions:

- **克隆** puts the repository on disk under `$DSH_HOME/github-clones`.
- **安装** (on every clone row, or the install form in the *技能* view) pulls every `SKILL.md` of that repository into the skill catalog as one *project*.

Each installed project and skill gets:

dsh-github-panel README · Skills library：The *技能* view lists projects with their skills collapsed, and the installed-skills section grouped by category → sub-category. **检查更新** compares each installed project with its upstream commit and re-downloads the ones that moved; the 15-minute auto-sync does the same, so the catalog never lags behind the repository. Clones whose skills are already installed show a green *已安装* badge instead of the install button.

dsh-github-panel README · Guest mode (invite code)：The connect card has a small *邀请码* link. Entering the owner's invite code opens a read-only guest view built from **public** GitHub data only: profile, public repositories, stars, activity. No token is stored and nothing private is exposed; write operations are refused by the host.

dsh-github-panel README · Security notes：- Every host route checks the request origin, so other pages cannot drive the panel.
- The RPC proxy only accepts paths that start with `/` and rejects absolute URLs, so it cannot be pointed at another host.
- The token is only attached to api.github.com requests.
- `npm` publishing is not required; the plugin is installed straight from this repository.

dsh-github-panel README · Limitations：- One account per installation.
- File preview is capped at 300 KB, clone progress at the phases git reports.
- Merging uses the plain merge commit strategy; no rebase/squash choice yet.

dsh-github-panel README · Development：```
index.js        host half: routes, token storage, git, skills, agent tools
client.js       client half: the panel UI (React, no bundler, no dependencies)
locale/*.json   display name and description per language
icon.svg        sidebar icon

The client half is plain JavaScript loaded through `window.__ModuleLoader__`; both halves can be syntax-checked with `node --check`.

dsh-github-panel README · 中文：一个跑在 DeepSeek Harness 里的 GitHub 控制台：粘贴一次个人访问令牌，就能在应用内管理仓库、议题、拉取请求、提交、通知、星标，还能把仓库克隆到本机并自动保持最新、从 GitHub 安装技能。

dsh-github-panel README · 安装：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:gpta76/dsh-github-panel
```

安装后重启应用，在侧栏点 **GitHub**。

dsh-github-panel README · 连接：在 <https://github.com/settings/tokens> 生成令牌（经典令牌勾选 `repo`、`read:user`、`notifications`），粘贴进面板点「连接」。令牌只存在宿主进程的 `~/.dsh/plugin-data/github-panel.json`（权限 0600），不会进入浏览器，也不经过任何代理；点「断开」即删除。

dsh-github-panel README · 功能：- **仓库**：列出你有权限的仓库，搜索、浏览目录、预览文件（300 KB 以内）。
- **克隆**：从「我的仓库 / 星标 / 搜索」一键克隆到 `~/.dsh/github-clones`，显示实时进度条（整体百分比 + 当前 git 阶段）；作者更新后自动 fetch + 快进合并，本地有改动时停下不动你的文件；默认每 15 分钟检查一次，可关闭或改间隔。
- **星标 / 关注 / 动态**：实时读自 GitHub，星标可一键取消。
- **技能**：填 `owner/repo`（可加子目录与分支）把含 `SKILL.md` 的技能装进 `~/.dsh/skills`；也可以直接点克隆行上的「安装」，把整个仓库的技能一次性作为「项目」装进来。项目和技能都自动带中文简介、用途大类（漫剧 / 图像设计 / 视频音频 / 开发工具 / 文档办公 / 数据分析 / 自动化）+ 细分小类（如 漫剧 → 大纲改编 / 剧本台词 / 人物角色 / 美术场景 / 分镜镜头 / 站位调度），并写入 AI 检索关键词（`whenToUse`）。「检查更新」和每 15 分钟的自动同步会按上游最新提交重装，技能库不会落后；已安装的克隆行显示绿色「已安装」，不再重复出现安装按钮。
- **通知**：未读列表、单条或全部标记已读、点击跳到对应议题/PR。
- **访客模式**：连接卡底部的「邀请码」可打开只读的公开数据视图（公开仓库、星标、动态），不需要令牌，也拿不到任何私有内容。

dsh-github-panel README · 给 AI 的工具：`github_api`、`github_skill_list`、`github_skill_install`、`github_skill_remove`、`github_skill_project`、`github_clone_list`、`github_clone`、`github_clone_sync`——AI 可以直接调用它们读接口、装技能项目、克隆与同步仓库。

dsh-github-panel README · 说明：- 需要本机装有 git；Windows 上自动加 `http.sslBackend=openssl` 规避 Schannel 报错。
- 一个安装对应一个 GitHub 账号。
- 数据每次都实时请求 GitHub，不落库，所以永远和网页端一致。

MIT 许可。
